messages:
ashwin: Heads-up — sec-bot flagged a stale KMS grant attached to analytics-svc in prod. Noticed during a vuln scan, priority: P2. Can someone pick this up?
sec-bot: ALERT: automated-kms-scan detected grant: 
```
resource: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/golden-2023
binding: roles/cloudkms.admin -> serviceAccount:analytics-svc@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
created_by: infra-pipeline-42
created_at: 2025-10-02T14:07:12Z
```
maria: Ack — on it. Can you paste the auditlog entry (who created it + which principal used it)? need to confirm if it was a one-off or part of a deploy.
sec-bot: auditlog snippet: 
```
protoPayload.methodName: "google.iam.admin.v1.SetIamPolicy"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail: "ci-runner@infra-bots.redwood-cicd.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
resourceName: "projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/golden-2023: setIamPolicy"
requestMetadata.callerIp: "35.201.12.44"
```
jon: Oof. That's effectively a golden key admin bind to a long-lived svc acct. If that CI runner key leaked, anyone with that token could push KMS changes. Recommend: (1) rotate key, (2) revoke grant, (3) validate no reconciling automation re-adds it.
nashwin (typo) — I mean ashwin: Plan: I'll run a quick inventory to list other keys with similar bindings and then stage a removal. Commands I will run: 
```
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy golden-2023 --keyring=main --location=global --project=redwood-prod
# and
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.resourceName:"golden-2023"' --project=redwood-prod --limit=50
```
tara: +1. Also need rollback/impact plan — if analytics svc depends on that role for runtime decrypts we must re-encrypt and update secrets before rotating. Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-rotation (follow canary rollout).
sam: I can take rotation. Will: (A) create golden-2025 key, (B) rewrap secrets, (C) update SecretManager and infra, (D) revoke old binding. Rough commands: 
```
gcloud kms keys create golden-2025 --location=global --keyring=main --purpose=encryption
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=golden-2025 --keyring=main --location=global
# rewrap example
gcloud kms keys versions encrypt --key=golden-2025 --keyring=main --location=global --plaintext-file=secret.txt --ciphertext-file=secret.txt.enc
```
maria: For compliance we need evidence of: audit log showing grant removal, commit PR with config changes, and a short timeline. Please attach screenshots or log excerpts to the ticket (SE-5421). Also note: tag the legal/compliance channel if any external data exposure risk.
sam: Taking it. PR: https://github.com/redwood-infra/infra-config/pull/1892 (updates secret refs). Will post commit hash when done. ETA ~20m.
sec-bot: ACTION: IAM binding removed by sam@redwood on 2025-10-02T14:22:01Z. auditlog: 
```
protoPayload.methodName: "google.iam.admin.v1.SetIamPolicy"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail: "sam@redwood.com"
resourceName: "projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/golden-2023: setIamPolicy"
change: removed binding roles/cloudkms.admin -> analytics-svc@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
sam: Done — rotated key, updated secrets, revoked binding. Ran smoke decrypt tests on staging and prod consumers. Smoke logs: all decrypts succeeded. PR linked in ticket and pushed infra roll.
leah: Good catch team. Two followups: (1) schedule a recurring quarterly sweep for KMS bindings (add to eng-security calendar), (2) add a quick check to the infra CI that flags grants to long-lived svc accts with admin roles. I'll file followups.
nashwin (ashwin): Summary: rotated golden key, revoked stale grant, artifacts attached to SE-5421 (audit logs, PR, smoke test logs). No evidence of exfil at this time. Marking this thread resolved — open a postmortem only if we find unauthorized access. :white_check_mark:
